# apple_app_encryption_declaration (Resource)

Declares how an app uses encryption, for export compliance. Assign it to builds with `apple_assign_encryption_declaration`. A declaration can't be changed, so changing any argument creates a new one, and App Store Connect can't delete one, so destroying the resource leaves it. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_encryption_declaration" "example" {
  app_id                            = data.apple_app.example.id
  app_description                   = "The app uses HTTPS only."
  contains_proprietary_cryptography = false
  contains_third_party_cryptography = false
  available_on_french_store         = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_description` (String) How the app uses encryption.
- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `available_on_french_store` (Boolean) Whether the app is available on the App Store in France.
- `contains_proprietary_cryptography` (Boolean) Whether the app contains proprietary cryptography.
- `contains_third_party_cryptography` (Boolean) Whether the app contains third-party cryptography.

### Read-Only

- `code_value` (String) Code to add to the app's `Info.plist` as `ITSEncryptionExportComplianceCode`, once approved.
- `created_date` (String) When the declaration was created.
- `exempt` (Boolean) Whether the app is exempt from export compliance documentation.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the declaration.
- `state` (String) State of the declaration, e.g. `CREATED` or `APPROVED`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_encryption_declaration.example
  identity = {
    id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the declaration.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_encryption_declaration.example 1234567890
```
